-- TX-16 (R): Adam Bauman wins R runoff over Manuel Barraza (69.9% vs 30.1%)
-- TX-16 D incumbent is Veronica Escobar
UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Veronica Escobar',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Adam Bauman',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Veronica Escobar (D) is the incumbent. Adam Bauman (R) won the May 26 Republican primary runoff over Manuel Barraza (69.9% vs 30.1%). Rated Solid D.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 16;

-- Check remaining Primary Runoff races in TX
SELECT id, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate2_name FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND status = 'Primary Runoff';
